AdultDVDEmpire Plex Metadata Agent

A Plex metadata agent that scrapes movie data from Adult DVD Empire. Supports search scoring, DVD/Blu-ray/VOD prioritization, cast photos, series collections, screenshots, and galleries.

Updates & source
Get the latest version, report issues, and follow changes on GitHub:
https://github.com/adultplexdev/AdultDVDEmpire.bundle

Install tip
Place the bundle as AdultDVDEmpire.bundle under your Plex Media Server Plug-ins folder, then restart Plex Media Server. Set this agent as the primary agent for the movie library (with Local Media Assets ordered as you prefer for local posters/art).

Matching tips
• Prefer clean filenames: Title (Year).ext works best.
• If search is weak, try Fix Match and lower the minimum match score, or enable debug logging and check the agent plugin log.
• DVD, Blu-ray, and VOD editions of the same title can appear separately - use Preferred media format to pick a default.

Privacy
Plex may collect library and viewing data. Consider that before installing any third-party agent. This agent contacts Adult DVD Empire over the network to fetch metadata and artwork.

Disclaimer
This agent is completely unaffiliated with Adult DVD Empire / AdultEmpire and is not endorsed by them. Site layout changes can break scraping until the agent is updated - check GitHub for fixes.
